floating.style.visibility = \"visible\";\n      })\n      .catch(() => {\n        if (activeTrigger === trigger && request === positionRequest) {\n          closeTooltip(false);\n        }\n activeTrigger === trigger ||\n      pendingTrigger === trigger\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    pendingTrigger = trigger;\n    const delay =\n      immediate || computePosition, flip, offset, shift, size } =\n    window.FloatingUIDOM;\n  const tooltipPlacements = new Set([\"top\", \"right\", \"bottom\", \"left\"]);\n  const tooltipId = `codex-visualization-tooltip-${\n    window.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ?? Date.now().toString(36)\n  }`;\n  const tooltipGap = 5;\n  const hoverDelay = 700;\n  const skipDelay = 300;\n  let activeTrigger = null;\n  let pendingTrigger = null;\n  let tooltip = null;\n  let openTimeout = null;\n  let autoUpdateCleanup = null;\n  let positionRequest = 0;\n  let skipDelayUntil = 0;\n\n  const getTrigger = (target) =>\n    target?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE\n      ? target.closest(\"[data-tooltip]\")\n      : null;\n  const containsTarget = (trigger, target) =>\n    target?.nodeType != null && trigger.contains(target);\n  const getContent = (trigger) =>\n    trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip\")?.trim() ?? \"\";\n  const getPlacement = (trigger) => {\n    const placement = trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip-placement\");\n    return tooltipPlacements.has(placement) ? placement : \"top\";\n  };\n  const getTooltip = () => {\n    if (tooltip == null) {\n      tooltip = document.createElement(\"div\");\n      tooltip.id = tooltipId;\n      tooltip.className = \"tooltip\";\n      tooltip.setAttribute(\"role\", \"tooltip\");\n    }\n    return tooltip;\n  };\n  const setDescribedBy = (trigger, described) => {\n    const ids = new Set(\n      (trigger.getAttribute(\"aria-describedby\") ?? \"\")\n        .split(/\\s+/)\n        .filter(Boolean),\n    );\n    if (described) {\n      ids.add(tooltipId);\n    } else {\n      ids.delete(tooltipId);\n    }\n    if (ids.size === 0) {\n      trigger.removeAttribute(\"aria-describedby\");\n    } else {\n      trigger.setAttribute(\"aria-describedby\", [...ids].join(\" \"));\n    }\n  };\n  const clearOpenTimeout = () => {\n    if (openTimeout != null) {\n      window.clearTimeout(openTimeout);\n      openTimeout = null;\n    }\n    pendingTrigger = null;\n  };\n  const closeTooltip = (activateSkipDelay = true) => {\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    positionRequest += 1;\n    autoUpdateCleanup?.();\n    autoUpdateCleanup = null;\n    if (activeTrigger == null) {\n      return;\n    }\n    setDescribedBy(activeTrigger, false);\n    activeTrigger = null;\n    tooltip?.remove();\n    if (activateSkipDelay) {\n      skipDelayUntil = Date.now() + skipDelay;\n    }\n  };\n  const updatePosition = (trigger, floating) => {\n    const request = ++positionRequest;\n    void computePosition(trigger, floating, {\n      middleware: [\n        offset(tooltipGap),\n        flip({ padding: tooltipGap }),\n        shift({ padding: tooltipGap }),\n        size({\n          padding: tooltipGap,\n          apply({ availableHeight, availableWidth, elements }) {\n elements.floating.style.setProperty(\n              \"--tooltip-available-height\",\n              `${Math.max(0, availableHeight)}px`,\n            );\n          },\n        }),\n      ],\n      placement: getPlacement(trigger),\n      strategy: \"fixed\",\n    })\n      .then(({ x, y }) => {\n        if (activeTrigger !== trigger || request !== positionRequest) {\n          return;\n        }\n        const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;\n        floating.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(x * scale) / scale}px, ${Math.round(y * scale) / scale}px)`;\n        floating.style.visibility = \"visible\";\n      })\n      .catch(() => {\n        if (activeTrigger === trigger && request === positionRequest) {\n          closeTooltip(false);\n        }\n      });\n  };\n  const openTooltip = (trigger) => {\n    const content = getContent(trigger);\n    if (!trigger.isConnected || content.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger) {\n      return;\n    }\n    closeTooltip();\n    const floating = getTooltip();\n    floating.textContent = content;\n    floating.style.visibility = \"hidden\";\n    floating.style.transform = \"translate(0, 0)\";\n    document.body.appendChild(floating);\n    activeTrigger = trigger;\n    setDescribedBy(trigger, true);\n    autoUpdateCleanup = autoUpdate(trigger, floating, () => {\n      updatePosition(trigger, floating);\n    });\n  };\n  const requestOpen = (trigger, immediate = false) => {\n    if (\n      getContent(trigger).length === 0 ||\n      activeTrigger === trigger ||\n      pendingTrigger === trigger\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    pendingTrigger = trigger;\n    const delay =\n      immediate || activeTrigger != null || Date.now() < skipDelayUntil\n        ? 0\n        : hoverDelay;\n    if (delay === 0) {\n      openTooltip(trigger);\n      return;\n    }\n    openTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => {\n      openTimeout = null;\n      pendingTrigger = null;\n      openTooltip(trigger);\n    }, delay);\n  };\n  const handlePointerOpen = (event) => {\n    if (event.pointerType === \"touch\") {\n      return;\n    }\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger == null || containsTarget(trigger, event.relatedTarget)) {\n      return;\n    }\n    requestOpen(trigger);\n  };\n  const handleLeave = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger == null || containsTarget(trigger, event.relatedTarget)) {\n      return;\n    }\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger || pendingTrigger === trigger) {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const handleFocusIn = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger?.matches(\":focus-visible\")) {\n      requestOpen(trigger, true);\n    }\n  };\n  const handleKeyDown = (event) => {\n    if (event.key === \"Escape\") {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const handleContextMenu = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger || pendingTrigger === trigger) {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const destroy = () => {\n    closeTooltip(false);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"pointerover\", handlePointerOpen);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"pointerout\", handleLeave);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"focusin\", handleFocusIn);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"focusout\", handleLeave);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"keydown\", handleKeyDown);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"contextmenu\", handleContextMenu);\n    tooltip = null;\n  };\n\n  document.addEventListener(\"pointerover\", handlePointerOpen);\n  document.addEventListener(\"pointerout\", handleLeave);\n  document.addEventListener(\"focusin\", handleFocusIn);\n  document.addEventListener(\"focusout\", handleLeave);\n  document.addEventListener(\"keydown\", handleKeyDown);\n  document.addEventListener(\"contextmenu\", handleContextMenu);\n '禁止提现':'禁止提交和执行提现；已进入打款流程的订单需单独拦截并提示财务复核。',\n    '禁止发布动态':'禁止用户发布新的文字、图片或视频动态；不删除历史动态，也不影响登录、聊天及房间功能。'\n  };\n  root.querySelectorAll('[data-control]').forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){\n    var name=b.getAttribute('data-control');\n root.querySelector('#rp-control-note').textContent=controlNotes[name];\n    root.querySelector('#rp-freeze-scope').style.display=name==='资产冻结'?'block':'none';\n    if(name==='资产冻结'){updateFreezeSelection();}else{root.querySelector('#rp-preview-action').textContent=name;}\n  });});\n  function updateFreezeSelection(){\n    var selected=[];\n src=\"https://unpkg.com/lucide@1.17.0/dist/umd/lucide.js\"></script>\n<script id=\"codex-visualization-tooltip\">/* oxlint-disable typescript/no-unsafe-argument, typescript/no-unsafe-call, typescript/no-unsafe-return */\n// Runs inside the visualization sandbox, not the host webview.\n(() => {\n  if (window.FloatingUIDOM == null) {\n    return;\n  }\n  const { autoUpdate, computePosition, flip, offset, shift, size } =\n    window.FloatingUIDOM;\n  const tooltipPlacements = new Set([\"top\", \"right\", \"bottom\", \"left\"]);\n  const tooltipId = `codex-visualization-tooltip-${\n    window.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ?? Date.now().toString(36)\n  }`;\n  const tooltipGap = 5;\n  const hoverDelay = 700;\n  const skipDelay = 300;\n  let activeTrigger = null;\n  let pendingTrigger = null;\n  let tooltip = null;\n  let openTimeout = null;\n  let autoUpdateCleanup = null;\n  let positionRequest = 0;\n  let skipDelayUntil = 0;\n\n  const getTrigger = (target) =>\n    target?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE\n      ? target.closest(\"[data-tooltip]\")\n      : null;\n  const containsTarget = (trigger, target) =>\n    target?.nodeType != null && trigger.contains(target);\n  const getContent = (trigger) =>\n    trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip\")?.trim() ?? \"\";\n  const getPlacement = (trigger) => {\n    const placement = trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip-placement\");\n    return tooltipPlacements.has(placement) ? placement : \"top\";\n  };\n  const getTooltip = () => {\n    if (tooltip == null) {\n      tooltip = document.createElement(\"div\");\n      tooltip.id = tooltipId;\n      tooltip.className = \"tooltip\";\n      tooltip.setAttribute(\"role\", \"tooltip\");\n    }\n    return tooltip;\n  };\n  const setDescribedBy = (trigger, described) => {\n    const ids = new Set(\n      (trigger.getAttribute(\"aria-describedby\") ?? \"\")\n        .split(/\\s+/)\n        .filter(Boolean),\n    );\n    if (described) {\n      ids.add(tooltipId);\n    } else {\n      ids.delete(tooltipId);\n    }\n    if (ids.size === 0) {\n      trigger.removeAttribute(\"aria-describedby\");\n    } else {\n      trigger.setAttribute(\"aria-describedby\", [...ids].join(\" \"));\n    }\n  };\n  const clearOpenTimeout = () => {\n    if (openTimeout != null) {\n      window.clearTimeout(openTimeout);\n      openTimeout = null;\n    }\n    pendingTrigger = null;\n  };\n  const closeTooltip = (activateSkipDelay = true) => {\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    positionRequest += 1;\n    autoUpdateCleanup?.();\n    autoUpdateCleanup = null;\n    if (activeTrigger == null) {\n      return;\n    }\n    setDescribedBy(activeTrigger, false);\n    activeTrigger = null;\n    tooltip?.remove();\n    if (activateSkipDelay) {\n      skipDelayUntil = Date.now() + skipDelay;\n    }\n  };\n  const updatePosition = (trigger, floating) => {\n    const request = ++positionRequest;\n    void computePosition(trigger, floating, {\n      middleware: [\n        offset(tooltipGap),\n        flip({ padding: tooltipGap }),\n        shift({ padding: tooltipGap }),\n        size({\n          padding: tooltipGap,\n          apply({ availableHeight, availableWidth, elements }) {\n            elements.floating.style.setProperty(\n              \"--tooltip-available-width\",\n              `${Math.max(0, availableWidth)}px`,\n            );\n            elements.floating.style.setProperty(\n              \"--tooltip-available-height\",\n              `${Math.max(0, availableHeight)}px`,\n            );\n          },\n        }),\n      ],\n      placement: getPlacement(trigger),\n      strategy: \"fixed\",\n    })\n      .then(({ x, y }) => {\n        if (activeTrigger !== trigger || request !== positionRequest) {\n          return;\n        }\n        const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;\n        floating.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(x * scale) / scale}px, ${Math.round(y * scale) / scale}px)`;\n        floating.style.visibility = \"visible\";\n      })\n      .catch(() => {\n        if (activeTrigger === trigger && request === positionRequest) {\n          closeTooltip(false);\n        }\n      });\n  };\n  const openTooltip = (trigger) => {\n    const content = getContent(trigger);\n    if (!trigger.isConnected || content.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger) {\n      return;\n    }\n    closeTooltip();\n    const floating = getTooltip();\n    floating.textContent = content;\n    floating.style.visibility = \"hidden\";\n id=\"codex-visualization-document-overflow\">html,body{overflow:hidden!important}</style>\n<script id=\"codex-visualization-floating-ui-core\" src=\"https://unpkg.com/lucide@1.17.0/dist/umd/lucide.js\"></script>\n<script id=\"codex-visualization-tooltip\">/* oxlint-disable typescript/no-unsafe-argument, typescript/no-unsafe-call, typescript/no-unsafe-return */\n// Runs inside the visualization sandbox, not the host webview.\n(() => {\n  if (window.FloatingUIDOM == null) {\n    return;\n  }\n  const { autoUpdate, computePosition, flip, offset, shift, size } =\n    window.FloatingUIDOM;\n  const tooltipPlacements = new Set([\"top\", \"right\", \"bottom\", \"left\"]);\n  const tooltipId = `codex-visualization-tooltip-${\n    window.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ?? Date.now().toString(36)\n  }`;\n  const tooltipGap = 5;\n  const hoverDelay = 700;\n  const skipDelay = 300;\n  let activeTrigger = null;\n  let pendingTrigger = null;\n  let tooltip = null;\n  let openTimeout = null;\n  let autoUpdateCleanup = null;\n  let positionRequest = 0;\n  let skipDelayUntil = 0;\n\n  const getTrigger = (target) =>\n    target?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE\n      ? target.closest(\"[data-tooltip]\")\n      : null;\n  const containsTarget = (trigger, target) =>\n    target?.nodeType != null && trigger.contains(target);\n  const getContent = (trigger) =>\n    trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip\")?.trim() ?? \"\";\n  const getPlacement = (trigger) => {\n    const placement = trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip-placement\");\n    return tooltipPlacements.has(placement) ? placement : \"top\";\n  };\n  const getTooltip = () => {\n    if (tooltip == null) {\n      tooltip = document.createElement(\"div\");\n      tooltip.id = tooltipId;\n      tooltip.className = \"tooltip\";\n      tooltip.setAttribute(\"role\", \"tooltip\");\n    }\n    return tooltip;\n  };\n  const setDescribedBy = (trigger, described) => {\n    const ids = new Set(\n      (trigger.getAttribute(\"aria-describedby\") ?? \"\")\n        .split(/\\s+/)\n        .filter(Boolean),\n    );\n    if (described) {\n      ids.add(tooltipId);\n    } else {\n      ids.delete(tooltipId);\n    }\n    if (ids.size === 0) {\n      trigger.removeAttribute(\"aria-describedby\");\n    } else {\n      trigger.setAttribute(\"aria-describedby\", [...ids].join(\" \"));\n    }\n  };\n  const clearOpenTimeout = () => {\n    if (openTimeout != null) {\n      window.clearTimeout(openTimeout);\n      openTimeout = null;\n    }\n    pendingTrigger = null;\n  };\n  const closeTooltip = (activateSkipDelay = true) => {\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    positionRequest += 1;\n    autoUpdateCleanup?.();\n    autoUpdateCleanup = null;\n    if (activeTrigger == null) {\n      return;\n    }\n    setDescribedBy(activeTrigger, false);\n    activeTrigger = null;\n    tooltip?.remove();\n    if (activateSkipDelay) {\n      skipDelayUntil = Date.now() + skipDelay;\n    }\n  };\n  const updatePosition = (trigger, floating) => {\n    const request = ++positionRequest;\n    void computePosition(trigger, floating, {\n      middleware: [\n        offset(tooltipGap),\n        flip({ padding: tooltipGap }),\n        shift({ padding: tooltipGap }),\n        size({\n          padding: tooltipGap,\n          apply({ availableHeight, availableWidth, elements }) {\n            elements.floating.style.setProperty(\n              \"--tooltip-available-width\",\n              `${Math.max(0, availableWidth)}px`,\n            );\n            elements.floating.style.setProperty(\n              \"--tooltip-available-height\",\n              `${Math.max(0, availableHeight)}px`,\n            );\n          },\n        }),\n      ],\n      placement: getPlacement(trigger),\n      strategy: \"fixed\",\n    })\n      .then(({ x, y }) => {\n        if (activeTrigger !== trigger || request !== positionRequest) {\n          return;\n        }\n        const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;\n        floating.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(x * scale) / scale}px, ${Math.round(y * scale) / scale}px)`;\n        floating.style.visibility = \"visible\";\n      })\n      .catch(() => {\n        if (activeTrigger === trigger && request === positionRequest) {\n          closeTooltip(false);\n        }\n      });\n  };\n  const openTooltip = (trigger) => {\n    const content = getContent(trigger);\n    if (!trigger.isConnected || content.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger) {\n      return;\n    }\n    closeTooltip();\n    const floating = getTooltip();\n    floating.textContent = content;\n    floating.style.visibility = \"hidden\";\n    floating.style.transform = \"translate(0, 0)\";\n    document.body.appendChild(floating);\n    activeTrigger = trigger;\n    setDescribedBy(trigger, true);\n    autoUpdateCleanup = autoUpdate(trigger, activeTrigger === trigger ||\n      pendingTrigger === trigger\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    pendingTrigger = trigger;\n    const delay =\n      immediate || activeTrigger != null || Date.now() < skipDelayUntil\n        ? 0\n        : hoverDelay;\n    if (delay === 0) {\n      openTooltip(trigger);\n      return;\n    }\n    openTimeout = (event.pointerType === \"touch\") {\n      return;\n    }\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger == null || containsTarget(trigger, event.relatedTarget)) {\n      return;\n return;\n    }\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger || pendingTrigger === trigger) {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const handleFocusIn = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger?.matches(\":focus-visible\")) {\n      requestOpen(trigger, true);\n    }\n  };\n  const handleKeyDown = (event) => {\n    if (event.key === \"Escape\") {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const handleContextMenu = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger || pendingTrigger === trigger) {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const destroy = () => {\n    closeTooltip(false);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"pointerover\", handlePointerOpen);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"pointerout\", handleLeave);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"focusin\", handleFocusIn);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"focusout\", handleLeave);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"keydown\", handleKeyDown);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"contextmenu\", handleContextMenu);\n    tooltip = null;\n  };\n\n  document.addEventListener(\"pointerover\", handlePointerOpen);\n  document.addEventListener(\"pointerout\", handleLeave);\n  document.addEventListener(\"focusin\", handleFocusIn);\n  document.addEventListener(\"focusout\", handleLeave);\n  document.addEventListener(\"keydown\", handleKeyDown);\n  document.addEventListener(\"contextmenu\", handleContextMenu);\n `codex-visualization-tooltip-${\n    window.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ?? Date.now().toString(36)\n  }`;\n  const tooltipGap = 5;\n  const hoverDelay = 700;\n  const skipDelay = 300;\n  let activeTrigger = null;\n  let pendingTrigger = null;\n  let tooltip = null;\n  let openTimeout = null;\n  let autoUpdateCleanup = null;\n  let positionRequest = 0;\n  let skipDelayUntil = 0;\n\n  const getTrigger = (target) =>\n    target?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE\n      ? target.closest(\"[data-tooltip]\")\n      : null;\n  const containsTarget = (trigger, target) =>\n    target?.nodeType != null && trigger.contains(target);\n  const getContent = (trigger) =>\n    trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip\")?.trim() ?? \"\";\n  const getPlacement = (trigger) => {\n    const placement = trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip-placement\");\n    return tooltipPlacements.has(placement) ? placement : \"top\";\n  };\n  const getTooltip = () => {\n    if (tooltip == null) {\n      tooltip = document.createElement(\"div\");\n      tooltip.id = tooltipId;\n      tooltip.className = \"tooltip\";\n      tooltip.setAttribute(\"role\", \"tooltip\");\n    }\n    return tooltip;\n  };\n  const setDescribedBy = (trigger, described) => {\n    const ids = new Set(\n      (trigger.getAttribute(\"aria-describedby\") ?? \"\")\n        .split(/\\s+/)\n        .filter(Boolean),\n    );\n    if (described) {\n      ids.add(tooltipId);\n    } else {\n      ids.delete(tooltipId);\n    }\n    if (ids.size === 0) {\n      trigger.removeAttribute(\"aria-describedby\");\n    } else {\n      trigger.setAttribute(\"aria-describedby\", [...ids].join(\" \"));\n    }\n  };\n  const clearOpenTimeout = () => {\n    if (openTimeout != null) {\n      window.clearTimeout(openTimeout);\n      openTimeout = null;\n    }\n    pendingTrigger = null;\n  };\n  const closeTooltip = (activateSkipDelay = true) => {\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    positionRequest += 1;\n    autoUpdateCleanup?.();\n    autoUpdateCleanup = null;\n    if (activeTrigger == null) {\n      return;\n    }\n    setDescribedBy(activeTrigger, false);\n    activeTrigger = null;\n    tooltip?.remove();\n    if (activateSkipDelay) {\n      skipDelayUntil = Date.now() + skipDelay;\n    }\n  };\n  const updatePosition = (trigger, floating) => {\n    const request = ++positionRequest;\n    void computePosition(trigger, floating, {\n      middleware: [\n        offset(tooltipGap),\n        flip({ padding: tooltipGap }),\n        shift({ padding: tooltipGap }),\n        size({\n          padding: tooltipGap,\n          apply({ availableHeight, availableWidth, elements }) {\n            elements.floating.style.setProperty(\n              \"--tooltip-available-width\",\n              `${Math.max(0, availableWidth)}px`,\n            );\n            elements.floating.style.setProperty(\n              \"--tooltip-available-height\",\n              `${Math.max(0, availableHeight)}px`,\n            );\n          },\n        }),\n      ],\n      placement: getPlacement(trigger),\n      strategy: \"fixed\",\n    })\n      .then(({ x, y }) => {\n        if (activeTrigger !== trigger || request !== positionRequest) {\n          return;\n        }\n        const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;\n        floating.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(x * scale) / scale}px, ${Math.round(y * scale) / scale}px)`;\n        floating.style.visibility = \"visible\";\n      })\n      .catch(() => {\n        if (activeTrigger === trigger && request === positionRequest) {\n          closeTooltip(false);\n        }\n      });\n  };\n  const openTooltip = (trigger) => {\n    const content = getContent(trigger);\n    if (!trigger.isConnected || content.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger) {\n      return;\n    }\n    closeTooltip();\n    const floating = getTooltip();\n    floating.textContent = content;\n    floating.style.visibility = \"hidden\";\n    floating.style.transform = \"translate(0, 0)\";\n    document.body.appendChild(floating);\n    activeTrigger = trigger;\n    setDescribedBy(trigger, true);\n    autoUpdateCleanup = autoUpdate(trigger, floating, () => {\n      updatePosition(trigger, floating);\n    });\n  };\n  const requestOpen = (trigger, immediate = false) => {\n    if (\n      getContent(trigger).length === 0 ||\n      activeTrigger === trigger ||\n      pendingTrigger === trigger\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    pendingTrigger = trigger;\n    const delay =\n      immediate || activeTrigger != null || Date.now() < skipDelayUntil\n        ? 0\n        : hoverDelay;\n    if (delay === 0) {\n      openTooltip(trigger);\n      return;\n    }\n    openTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => {\n      openTimeout = null;\n      pendingTrigger = null;\n      openTooltip(trigger);\n    }, delay);\n  };\n  const handlePointerOpen = (event) => {\n    if (event.pointerType === \"touch\") {\n      return;\n    }\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger == null || containsTarget(trigger, event.relatedTarget)) {\n      return;\n    }\n    requestOpen(trigger);\n  };\n  const handleLeave = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger == null || containsTarget(trigger, event.relatedTarget)) {\n      return;\n    }\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger || pendingTrigger === trigger) {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const handleFocusIn = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger?.matches(\":focus-visible\")) {\n      requestOpen(trigger, true);\n    }\n  };\n  const handleKeyDown = (event) => {\n    if (event.key === \"Escape\") {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const handleContextMenu = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger || pendingTrigger === trigger) {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const destroy = () => {\n    closeTooltip(false);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"pointerover\", handlePointerOpen);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"pointerout\", handleLeave);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"focusin\", handleFocusIn);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"focusout\", handleLeave);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"keydown\", handleKeyDown);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"contextmenu\", handleContextMenu);\n    tooltip = null;\n  };\n\n  document.addEventListener(\"pointerover\", handlePointerOpen);\n  document.addEventListener(\"pointerout\", handleLeave);\n  document.addEventListener(\"focusin\", handleFocusIn);\n  document.addEventListener(\"focusout\", handleLeave);\n  document.addEventListener(\"keydown\", handleKeyDown);\n  document.addEventListener(\"contextmenu\", handleContextMenu);\n computePosition, flip, offset, shift, size } =\n    window.FloatingUIDOM;\n  const tooltipPlacements = new Set([\"top\", \"right\", \"bottom\", \"left\"]);\n  const tooltipId = `codex-visualization-tooltip-${\n    window.crypto?.randomUUID?.() ?? Date.now().toString(36)\n  }`;\n  const tooltipGap = 5;\n  const hoverDelay = 700;\n  const skipDelay = 300;\n  let activeTrigger = null;\n  let pendingTrigger = null;\n  let tooltip = null;\n  let openTimeout = null;\n  let autoUpdateCleanup = null;\n  let positionRequest = 0;\n  let skipDelayUntil = 0;\n\n  const getTrigger = (target) =>\n    target?.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE\n      ? target.closest(\"[data-tooltip]\")\n      : null;\n  const containsTarget = (trigger, target) =>\n    target?.nodeType != null && trigger.contains(target);\n  const getContent = (trigger) =>\n    trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip\")?.trim() ?? \"\";\n  const getPlacement = (trigger) => {\n    const placement = trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip-placement\");\n    return tooltipPlacements.has(placement) ? placement : \"top\";\n  };\n  const getTooltip = () => {\n    if (tooltip == null) {\n      tooltip = document.createElement(\"div\");\n      tooltip.id = tooltipId;\n      tooltip.className = \"tooltip\";\n      tooltip.setAttribute(\"role\", \"tooltip\");\n    }\n    return tooltip;\n  };\n  const setDescribedBy = (trigger, described) => {\n    const ids = new Set(\n      (trigger.getAttribute(\"aria-describedby\") ?? \"\")\n        .split(/\\s+/)\n        .filter(Boolean),\n    );\n    if (described) {\n      ids.add(tooltipId);\n    } else {\n      ids.delete(tooltipId);\n    }\n    if (ids.size === 0) {\n      trigger.removeAttribute(\"aria-describedby\");\n    } else {\n      trigger.setAttribute(\"aria-describedby\", [...ids].join(\" \"));\n    }\n  };\n  const clearOpenTimeout = () => {\n    if (openTimeout != null) {\n      window.clearTimeout(openTimeout);\n      openTimeout = null;\n    }\n    pendingTrigger = null;\n  };\n  const closeTooltip = (activateSkipDelay = true) => {\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    positionRequest += 1;\n    autoUpdateCleanup?.();\n    autoUpdateCleanup = null;\n    if (activeTrigger == null) {\n      return;\n    }\n    setDescribedBy(activeTrigger, false);\n    activeTrigger = null;\n    tooltip?.remove();\n    if (activateSkipDelay) {\n      skipDelayUntil = Date.now() + skipDelay;\n    }\n  };\n  const updatePosition = (trigger, floating) => {\n    const request = ++positionRequest;\n    void computePosition(trigger, floating, {\n      middleware: [\n        offset(tooltipGap),\n        flip({ padding: tooltipGap }),\n        shift({ padding: tooltipGap }),\n        size({\n          padding: tooltipGap,\n          apply({ availableHeight, availableWidth, elements }) {\n            elements.floating.style.setProperty(\n              \"--tooltip-available-width\",\n              `${Math.max(0, availableWidth)}px`,\n            );\n            elements.floating.style.setProperty(\n              \"--tooltip-available-height\",\n              `${Math.max(0, availableHeight)}px`,\n            );\n          },\n        }),\n      ],\n      placement: getPlacement(trigger),\n      strategy: \"fixed\",\n    })\n      .then(({ x, y }) => {\n        if (activeTrigger !== trigger || request !== positionRequest) {\n          return;\n        }\n        const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;\n        floating.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(x * scale) / scale}px, ${Math.round(y * scale) / scale}px)`;\n        floating.style.visibility = \"visible\";\n      })\n      .catch(() => {\n        if (activeTrigger === trigger && request === positionRequest) {\n          closeTooltip(false);\n        }\n      });\n  };\n  const openTooltip = (trigger) => {\n    const content = getContent(trigger);\n    if (!trigger.isConnected || content.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger) {\n      return;\n    }\n    closeTooltip();\n    const floating = getTooltip();\n    floating.textContent = content;\n    floating.style.visibility = \"hidden\";\n    floating.style.transform = \"translate(0, 0)\";\n    document.body.appendChild(floating);\n    activeTrigger = trigger;\n    setDescribedBy(trigger, true);\n    autoUpdateCleanup = autoUpdate(trigger, floating, () => {\n      updatePosition(trigger, floating);\n    });\n  };\n  const requestOpen = (trigger, immediate = false) => {\n    if (\n      getContent(trigger).length === 0 ||\n      activeTrigger === trigger ||\n      pendingTrigger === trigger\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    pendingTrigger = trigger;\n    const delay =\n      immediate || activeTrigger != null || Date.now() < skipDelayUntil\n        ? 0\n        : hoverDelay;\n    if (delay === 0) {\n      openTooltip(trigger);\n      return;\n    }\n    openTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => {\n      openTimeout = null;\n      pendingTrigger = null;\n      openTooltip(trigger);\n    }, delay);\n  };\n  const handlePointerOpen = (event) => {\n    if (event.pointerType === \"touch\") {\n      return;\n    }\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger == null || containsTarget(trigger, event.relatedTarget)) {\n      return;\n    }\n    requestOpen(trigger);\n  };\n  const handleLeave = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger == null || containsTarget(trigger, event.relatedTarget)) {\n      return;\n    }\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger || pendingTrigger === trigger) {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const handleFocusIn = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger?.matches(\":focus-visible\")) {\n      requestOpen(trigger, true);\n    }\n  };\n  const handleKeyDown = (event) => {\n    if (event.key === \"Escape\") {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const handleContextMenu = (event) => {\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger || pendingTrigger === trigger) {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const destroy = () => {\n    closeTooltip(false);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"pointerover\", handlePointerOpen);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"pointerout\", handleLeave);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"focusin\", handleFocusIn);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"focusout\", handleLeave);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"keydown\", handleKeyDown);\n    document.removeEventListener(\"contextmenu\", handleContextMenu);\n    tooltip = null;\n  };\n\n  document.addEventListener(\"pointerover\", handlePointerOpen);\n  document.addEventListener(\"pointerout\", handleLeave);\n  document.addEventListener(\"focusin\", handleFocusIn);\n  document.addEventListener(\"focusout\", handleLeave);\n  document.addEventListener(\"keydown\", handleKeyDown);\n  document.addEventListener(\"contextmenu\", handleContextMenu);\n activeTrigger === trigger ||\n      pendingTrigger === trigger\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    pendingTrigger = trigger;\n    const delay =\n      immediate || Date.now().toString(36)\n  }`;\n  const tooltipGap = 5;\n  const hoverDelay = 700;\n  const skipDelay = 300;\n  let activeTrigger = null;\n  let pendingTrigger = null;\n  let tooltip = null;\n  let target.closest(\"[data-tooltip]\")\n      : null;\n  const containsTarget = (trigger, target) =>\n    target?.nodeType != null && trigger.contains(target);\n  const getContent = (trigger) =>\n    trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip\")?.trim() ?? \"\";\n  const getPlacement = (trigger) => {\n    const placement = trigger.getAttribute(\"data-tooltip-placement\");\n    return tooltipPlacements.has(placement) ? placement : \"top\";\n  };\n  const getTooltip = () => {\n    if (tooltip == null) {\n      tooltip = document.createElement(\"div\");\n      tooltip.id = };\n  const updatePosition = (trigger, floating) => {\n    const request = ++positionRequest;\n    void computePosition(trigger, floating, {\n      middleware: [\n        offset(tooltipGap),\n elements.floating.style.setProperty(\n              \"--tooltip-available-height\",\n              `${Math.max(0, availableHeight)}px`,\n            );\n          },\n        }),\n      ],\n      placement: getPlacement(trigger),\n      strategy: \"fixed\",\n    })\n      .then(({ x, y }) => {\n        if (activeTrigger !== trigger || request !== positionRequest) {\n          return;\n        }\n        const scale = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;\n        floating.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(x * scale) / scale}px, ${Math.round(y * scale) / scale}px)`;\n        floating.style.visibility = \"visible\";\n      })\n      .catch(() => {\n        if (activeTrigger === trigger && request === positionRequest) {\n          closeTooltip(false);\n        }\n      });\n  };\n  const openTooltip = (trigger) => {\n    const content = getContent(trigger);\n    if (!trigger.isConnected || content.length === 0) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger) {\n      return;\n    }\n    closeTooltip();\n    const floating = getTooltip();\n    floating.textContent = content;\n    floating.style.visibility = \"hidden\";\n    floating.style.transform = \"translate(0, 0)\";\n    document.body.appendChild(floating);\n    activeTrigger = trigger;\n    setDescribedBy(trigger, true);\n    autoUpdateCleanup = autoUpdate(trigger, activeTrigger === trigger ||\n      pendingTrigger === trigger\n    ) {\n      return;\n    }\n    clearOpenTimeout();\n    pendingTrigger = trigger;\n    const delay =\n      immediate || activeTrigger != null || Date.now() < skipDelayUntil\n        ? 0\n        : hoverDelay;\n    if (delay === 0) {\n      openTooltip(trigger);\n      return;\n    }\n    openTimeout = window.setTimeout(() => {\n      openTimeout = null;\n      pendingTrigger = null;\n      openTooltip(trigger);\n    }, delay);\n  };\n  const handlePointerOpen = (event) => {\n    if (event.pointerType === \"touch\") {\n      return;\n    }\n    const trigger = getTrigger(event.target);\n    if (trigger == null || containsTarget(trigger, event.relatedTarget)) {\n      return;\n return;\n    }\n    if (activeTrigger === trigger || pendingTrigger === trigger) {\n      closeTooltip();\n    }\n  };\n  const handleFocusIn = (event) => {\n    const trigger = 94d4","saserver-westus3-prod.fck9d:conversation-turn-e848048e-e505-4eaf-b2ca-988b2a9094d4:US","conversation-turn-e848048e-e505-4eaf-b2ca-988b2a9094d4",{"_462":4774,"_464":465,"_466":-5,"_467":4775},"6a869ef5c0708191b7f43b5b236a702f","2026-08-20T06:30:14.846798+00:00",[4777],"可以将该功能定义为「批量奖励发放系统」，核心目标是：运营提交、系统校验、多人审核、受控执行、全程留痕，避免错发、重复发放和超额发放。\n\n## 一、功能流程\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    A[\"运营上传奖励表\"] --> B[\"系统解析与校验\"]\n    B -->|存在异常| C[\"返回错误明细\"]\n    C --> A\n    B -->|校验通过| D[\"生成发放批次\"]\n    D --> E[\"一级审核\"]\n    E -->|驳回| F[\"退回并填写原因\"]\n    E -->|通过| G[\"二级审核\"]\n    G -->|驳回| F\n    G -->|通过| H[\"系统执行发放\"]\n    H --> I[\"生成发放结果与操作日志\"]\n```\n\n## 二、上传表格字段\n\n建议使用 Excel 模板，字段如下：\n\n| 字段 | 是否必填 | 说明 |\n|---|---:|---|\n| 用户ID | 是 | 根据ID识别用户 |\n| 奖励类型 | 是 | 金币、钻石、游戏币、VIP、头像框、座驾、靓号等 |\n| 奖励数量/时长 | 是 | 数量或有效天数 |\n| 奖励物品ID | 条件必填 | 头像框、座驾等物品必须填写 |\n| 发放原因 | 是 | 活动奖励、补偿、运营奖励等 |\n| 关联活动/事件编号 | 否 | 方便追溯 |\n| 备注 | 否 | 补充说明 |\n\n一次上传可以支持多个用户，但建议同一批次只允许一种奖励类型，减少误操作风险。\n\n## 三、系统自动校验\n\n上传后不允许立即发送，系统必须先完成以下检查：\n\n1. 用户ID是否存在、是否被封禁、账号状态是否正常。\n2. 显示用户ID、昵称、国家、公会等信息，方便运营核对。\n3. 奖励类型和物品ID是否有效。\n4. 奖励数量是否为合法正数。\n5. 是否超过单用户、单批次、单日发放上限。\n6. 表格内是否存在重复用户ID。\n7. 相同用户、相同奖励、相同原因是否近期已经发放。\n8. 是否存在空值、格式错误或异常大额数据。\n9. 自动计算本批次总人数、总奖励数量及预计价值。\n10. 错误数据必须阻止提交，并支持下载错误明细。\n\n系统应重点突出异常数据，例如：\n\n- 单个用户金币数量异常；\n- 同一用户重复出现；\n- 用户ID与昵称核对异常；\n- 本批次金额比运营历史平均值明显偏高。\n\n## 四、审核机制\n\n建议采用分级审核：\n\n| 发放规模 | 审核要求 |\n|---|---|\n| 普通小额批次 | 运营主管一级审核 |\n| 中额或特殊物品 | 运营主管＋高级管理员二级审核 |\n| 大额金币、VIP6/7、靓号等 | 运营负责人＋财务/最高管理员审核 |\n\n审核页面必须展示：\n\n- 申请人及申请时间；\n- 发放原因；\n- 用户总数；\n- 各奖励总数量；\n- 奖励折算价值；\n- 重复或异常提醒；\n- 部分用户明细；\n- 原始上传文件；\n- 通过、驳回按钮及审核意见。\n\n申请人不能审核自己的申请，审核通过后也不能修改数据。\n\n## 五、执行与防错机制\n\n1. 审核通过后，由系统后台任务执行，不能由技术人员手动修改数据库。\n2. 每个批次生成唯一批次号。\n3. 每条奖励生成唯一流水号，避免系统重试造成重复发放。\n4. 执行前进行第二次数据校验。\n5. 支持立即发放和定时发放。\n6. 发放过程中显示进度：待发送、发送中、成功、失败。\n7. 失败数据可单独重试，已经成功的数据不得再次发送。\n8. 审核通过后、执行前可由最高权限管理员紧急终止。\n9. 原则上不提供普通“撤回”功能；如需追回，必须走独立的奖励扣回审批流程。\n10. 超大额奖励可以增加二次确认或动态验证码。\n\n## 六、批次状态\n\n建议设置以下状态：\n\n- 草稿\n- 校验失败\n- 待一级审核\n- 待二级审核\n- 已驳回\n- 待执行\n- 发放中\n- 部分成功\n- 全部成功\n- 已终止\n- 已撤销申请\n\n## 七、权限管理\n\n| 角色 | 权限 |\n|---|---|\n| 普通运营 | 下载模板、上传、查看本人记录、提交审核 |\n| 运营主管 | 查看团队申请、一级审核、驳回 |\n| 高级管理员 | 二级审核、终止待执行批次 |\n| 财务/负责人 | 审核大额或高价值奖励 |\n| 超级管理员 | 配置限额、奖励类型、审核规则 |\n| 技术人员 | 查看技术日志，不允许直接发奖励 |\n\n## 八、记录与追溯\n\n所有操作必须永久留痕，包括：\n\n- 上传人、审核人、执行人；\n- 操作时间、IP、设备信息；\n- 上传前后的文件；\n- 审核意见和驳回原因；\n- 每个用户发放前后的资产余额；\n- 发放接口返回结果；\n- 失败原因及重试记录；\n- 是否触发风控规则。\n\n支持根据用户ID、批次号、申请人、时间、奖励类型和状态查询，并导出结果。\n\n## 九、关键安全规则\n\n- 禁止直接在后台输入超大金额后立即发送。\n- 禁止申请人审核自己的奖励。\n- 禁止修改已提交或已审核的批次。\n- 同一个Excel文件不能重复提交。\n- 同一批次请求必须具备幂等机制，防止网络重试导致重复到账。\n- 发放上限、审核层级必须可配置。\n- 大额批次执行前向负责人发送系统提醒。\n-
